description: BILLABLE: creates a paid image task charged to the user's APIKO balance. Only call after estimate_cost on the same input and the user's explicit approval of the model and cost. With reference images in input.images it edits (POST /v1/images/edits), otherwise it generates. The input is validated against the model schema first. Runs async when the model supports it and waits up to wait_seconds; if not done, poll with get_task. Never call again to check progress.

client_request_id.description: Your id for this one approved request (8-96 chars of letters, digits, . _ -). Reusing it with the same input returns the earlier task instead of charging twice.

input.description: Model request fields exactly as listed in get_model input_schema (e.g. {"prompt": "...", "resolution": "2k"}). Leave out model and async.

max_cost_usd.description: Budget the user approved; the call is refused if the estimate (or its upper bound) is higher or cannot be computed.

prompt.description: Shortcut for input.prompt; give the prompt once.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 30).

name: generate_image
title: Generate or edit an image (billable)
